data-component-id="3136889" data-component-type="TideLandingPageContent"><!----><!--[--><div class="rpl-content" layout-area="body"><h2 id="road-trauma-statistical-summary-reports">Road Trauma Statistical Summary Reports</h2><p>Statistical Summaries for 2023 and 2024 are available to help make our road crash data easier to understand.</p><p>These reports highlight:</p><ul><li>key changes and trends over the past 10 years and give a clear picture of where crashes happened, who was affected, and what kinds of vehicles were involved</li><li>information on drivers, riders, passengers, cyclists, pedestrians and more – from both city and country areas</li><li>new data on licensing and registration, drivers and rider toxicology data and MAIS 3+ injury data, and</li><li>it expands on data currently available on the Transport Victoria Open Data Portal.</li></ul><p><a href="/victorian-road-trauma-statistics" data-entity-type="node" data-entity-uuid="8a0ac311-856e-452b-abd4-10ba9e386f7a" data-entity-substitution="canonical" title="Victorian road trauma statistics" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Go to Statistical Summary Report</a></p><h2 id="road-crash-stats-dashboard">Road Crash Stats Dashboard</h2><p>The Road Crash Stats Dashboard draws on published crash data, allowing users to analyse, summarise and visualise data from 2012 onwards. Users can also build their own queries.</p><p><a href="https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data?v=0#use_cases" target="_blank" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Go to the dashboard<span class="rpl-u-visually-hidden">(opens in a new window)</span></a>.</p><h2 id="road-crash-map">Road Crash Map</h2><p>The Road Crash Map presents crash data spatially from 2012 onwards, helping users identify high-risk areas and visualise patterns across the road network.</p><p><a href="https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data?v=1#use_cases" target="_blank" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Go to the map<span class="rpl-u-visually-hidden">(opens in a new window)</span></a>.</p><h2 id="victoria-road-crash-data">Victoria Road Crash data</h2><p>We publish Victoria’s road crash data on <a href="https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data" target="_blank" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Transport Victoria Open Data Portal<span class="rpl-u-visually-hidden">(opens in a new window)</span></a> and <a href="https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data" target="_blank" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Victorian Government Open Data Portal<span class="rpl-u-visually-hidden">(opens in a new window)</span></a> — giving easy access to a wide range of Victorian transport datasets, available to everyone who wants it.</p><p>The data provides users with information about Victorian fatal and injury road crashes based on time, location, conditions, crash type, road user type and other relevant attributes.</p><p>Information is updated monthly and has a 7-month lag in order to allow time for reports to be completed and data to be verified before public release. .</p><p><a href="https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data" target="_blank" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">Go to Transport Victoria Open Data Portal<span class="rpl-u-visually-hidden">(opens in a new window)</span></a>.</p><h2 id="road-crash-information-system">Road Crash Information System</h2><p>Road Crash Information System is a database maintained by DTP. It’s based on crash reports compiled by Victoria Police and injury information forwarded by the Transport Accident Commission.</p><p>We use this data to produce our resources on this webpage — making it easier for all users to access the information they need.</p><h2 id="restricted-resources">Restricted Resources</h2><p>Access to Road Crash Information System is restricted due to the sensitive nature of the data. It’s available to state and local government road asset managers.</p><p>Road Crash Information System provides tools for analysing road crashes in Victoria. This platform allows local government-based road safety practitioners to better understand some of the key issues about road crashes and to tailor road safety initiatives for local communities.</p><p>Road asset managers who need access to this database can apply by completing the form below and email - <a href="mailto:crashstats_support@roads.vic.gov.au" class="rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline">crashstats_support@roads.vic.gov.au</a>.</p>

highlight:\u003C/p>\u003Cul>\u003Cli>key changes and trends over the past 10 years and give a clear picture of where crashes happened, who was affected, and what kinds of vehicles were involved\u003C/li>\u003Cli>information on drivers, riders, passengers, cyclists, pedestrians and more – from both city and country areas\u003C/li>\u003Cli>new data on licensing and registration, href=\"/victorian-road-trauma-statistics\" data-entity-type=\"node\" data-entity-uuid=\"8a0ac311-856e-452b-abd4-10ba9e386f7a\" data-entity-substitution=\"canonical\" title=\"Victorian road trauma Road Crash Stats Dashboard draws on published crash data, allowing users to analyse, summarise and visualise data from 2012 onwards. Users can also build their own queries.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>\u003Ca href=\"https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data?v=0#use_cases\" target=\"_blank\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">Go to the dashboard\u003Cspan class=\"rpl-u-visually-hidden\">(opens in a new window)\u003C/span>\u003C/a>.\u003C/p>\u003Ch2 id=\"road-crash-map\">Road Crash Map\u003C/h2>\u003Cp>The Road Crash Map presents crash data spatially from 2012 onwards, helping users identify high-risk areas and visualise patterns across the road network.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>\u003Ca href=\"https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data?v=1#use_cases\" target=\"_blank\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">Go to the map\u003Cspan class=\"rpl-u-visually-hidden\">(opens in a new window)\u003C/span>\u003C/a>.\u003C/p>\u003Ch2 id=\"victoria-road-crash-data\">Victoria Road Crash data\u003C/h2>\u003Cp>We publish Victoria’s road crash data on \u003Ca href=\"https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data\" target=\"_blank\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">Transport Victoria Open Data Portal\u003Cspan class=\"rpl-u-visually-hidden\">(opens in a new window)\u003C/span>\u003C/a> and \u003Ca href=\"https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data\" target=\"_blank\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">Victorian Government Open Data Portal\u003Cspan class=\"rpl-u-visually-hidden\">(opens in a new window)\u003C/span>\u003C/a> — giving easy access to a wide range of Victorian transport datasets, available to everyone who wants it.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>The data provides users with information about Victorian fatal and injury road crashes based on time, location, conditions, crash type, road user type and other relevant attributes.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>Information is updated monthly and has a 7-month lag in order to allow time for reports to be completed and data to be verified before public release. .\u003C/p>\u003Cp>\u003Ca href=\"https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data\" target=\"_blank\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">Go to Transport Victoria Open Data Portal\u003Cspan class=\"rpl-u-visually-hidden\">(opens in a new window)\u003C/span>\u003C/a>.\u003C/p>\u003Ch2 id=\"road-crash-information-system\">Road Crash Information System\u003C/h2>\u003Cp>Road Crash Information System is a database maintained by DTP. It’s based on crash reports compiled by Victoria Police and injury information forwarded by the Transport Accident Commission.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>We use this data to produce our resources on this webpage — making it easier for all users to access the information they need.\u003C/p>\u003Ch2 id=\"restricted-resources\">Restricted Resources\u003C/h2>\u003Cp>Access to Road Crash Information System is restricted due to the sensitive nature of the data. It’s available to state and local government road asset managers.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>Road Crash Information System provides tools for analysing road crashes in Victoria. This platform allows local government-based road safety practitioners to better understand some of the key issues about road crashes and to tailor road safety initiatives for local communities.\u003C/p>\u003Cp>Road asset managers who need access to this database can apply by completing the form below and email - \u003Ca href=\"mailto:crashstats_support@roads.vic.gov.au\" class=\"rpl-text-link rpl-u-focusable-inline\">crashstats_support@roads.vic.gov.au\u003C/a>.\u003C/p>\n\u003Cfigure class=\"rpl-document\">\n  \u003Ca class=\"rpl-document__link rpl-u-focusable-within\" aria-label=\"Deed for access to restricted crash data File type: Word.
